data.name: Dilnashrath
data.gender_notes: Dilnashrath is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She who is a source of delight and pleasure. The name Dilnashrath carries the meaning “Delightful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dilnashrath usually hope their child will grow to embody delightful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a woman who brings joy and happiness to those around her, inspiring them with her grace and kindness
data.etymology: Dilnashrath belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delightful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dilnashrath total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: ديلناشراث
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على قوة و نصر و تأييد من الله تعالى
in_arabic.long_meaning: ديلناشراث هو اسم مركب من ديل و ناشراث و هو يعني الشخص الذي ينشر الخير و النصر و التأييد من الله تعالى. و هو اسم ذو معنى عميق في الثقافة الإسلامية و يوحي بالقوة و الصبر و النصر.

in_urdu.name: دیلناشراث
in_urdu.meaning: نام جو اللہ تعالی کی طاقت اور نصرت کا اشارہ کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: دیلناشراث ایک مرکب نام ہے جو دیل اور ناشراث سے بنا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو اللہ تعالی کی طرف سے نصرت اور تأیید کو پھیلاتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں گہرا معنی رکھتا ہے اور طاقت، صبر اور نصرت کا اشارہ کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: दिलनाशराथ
in_hindi.meaning: यह नाम ईश्वर की शक्ति और समर्थन की ओर संकेत करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: दिलनाशराथ एक मिश्रित नाम है जो दिल और नाशराथ से बना है। इसका अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो ईश्वर की ओर से समर्थन और सहायता को फैलाता है। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में गहरा अर्थ रखता है और शक्ति, धैर्य और समर्थन की ओर संकेत करता है।

in_pashto.name: ديلناشراث
in_pashto.meaning: دغه نوم د الله تعالی د قدرت او نصرت اشاره کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: ديلناشراث يو مرکب نوم دی چې د ديل او ناشراث څخه جوړ شوی دی. دغه نوم د هغه چا معنی دی چې د الله تعالی لخوا د نصرت او تأیید په خپرولو کې دی. دا نوم په اسلامي کلتور کې ژور معنی لري او د قدرت، صبر او نصرت اشاره کوي.

in_english.name: Dilnashrath
in_english.meaning: Name indicating strength and support from Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Dilnashrath is a compound name derived from 'dil' and 'nashrath', signifying one who spreads goodness, victory, and support from Allah. This name holds deep significance in Islamic culture, suggesting strength, patience, and triumph. Etymologically, it relates to Arabic roots emphasizing divine assistance and propagation of righteousness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dilnashrath, in Persian origin, is known to evoke deep emotions of love, delight, and pleasure. In Islamic and Persian cultures, naming daughters after beautiful and emotionally evocative names has been a common practice, and Dilnashrath is no exception. A little girl named Dilnashrath would be cherished, admired, and doted upon, just as the name suggests. The name would undoubtedly cause a ripple effect of joy, warmth, and love within her family and community.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic and Sufi traditions, the concept of inner delight is profound and deeply spiritual. The path to spiritual enlightenment is often described as a journey towards experiencing inner joy and pleasure. The name Dilnashrath, therefore, carries a deep spiritual significance. It symbolizes the inner joy and pleasure that comes from living in accordance with Islamic principles, striving towards self-improvement and spiritual growth. It serves as a constant reminder for the bearer of the name to seek and cultivate inner joy, rather than relying on external sources.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Delightful" symbolizes She who is a source of delight and pleasure. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Dilnashrath serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of delightful.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir, Al-Bidayah wa-l-Nihayah, 1304 AH, Vol. 11, p. 155 The name Dilnashrath carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ibn Kathir mentions a woman named Dilnashrath who was a wife of Imam Al-Hussein (as) and was martyred with him at Karbala.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Dilnashrath remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
